turns.question: Who was our best customer in September 2026, and how much did they spend?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no such metric: it cannot rank or name individual customers, because no metric has a per-customer dimension (revenue can only be split by customer country, signup date, order status, amount and time). The closest metrics are revenue_eur (Revenue, EUR), customers_distinct (Active customers) and repeat_customers, which I can give in total or by customer country for September 2026 if you want.
